about: Decision D1 §9 (16.11.2026, plan/decisions-2026-11-16-d1.md), made by Claude under the owner's delegation of 16.11.2026 21:53: the open PRs stacked on older trains (base neither verify/train-7 nor main) stay open; none is closed by a lane. verify/train-7 supersedes them: a PR whose head is an ancestor of the train head is in it (inTrain), and every other one has its decision in plan/train-missing.json at the same head. GitHub closes a PR on its own once its head reaches its base; a lane never closes one. src/__tests__/stackedPrsLedger.test.ts checks this file against train-missing.json.
